entry.title: What certification can measure ability of a data analyst? None!
entry.content:
It is unwise to measure the ability of a data analyst by solely using certification awarded by some organization.This is just my own humble view point.

There are some points that supports my claim

The latency between front line knowledge used in daily operation and the exam designed by the organization like schools or other types of organization.
The main reason behind this latency is that such organization doesn’t meet the problems faced in each industry, or each field.
I have been working on data analysis works like sales planning, SCM planning for several years, I know that in everyday there would be new problems generated, and there are problems have been fixed.
Because that once a company resolve a problem, they will be benefited directly, so they have motivation to solve it.
While, for education org or other certification award group, they really don’t have this motivation behind them, so the exam they provided is too basic and outdated, as far as the exam that I attended, it is like this.

The subject structured by education organization doesn’t fit my expectation
I think this is a general problem can be applied to everyone.
Take myself as example, I would not consider myself as an expert in some field, but I can say that I am a useful person, because I have been learning on everyday basis, and applying the knowledge I learned to solve problems
My interest is really wide, for example:
a. Economic of money and banking
b. Finance
c. Accounting
c. Data analytic techniques
d. Statistics
e. Machine learning
f. History
g. Mathematics
…
I would periodically learn each of the subject, and I can get lots of insights from the interdiscipline created by myself. And I am sure that my data analytic skills were created with the help from all of above subjects.
Honestly, I can’t give up any of above subject, any of them contributes a lot to myself.
While, I don’t think any organization can offer a exam/certification can cover all the subjects above.

Memorize a thing can help you to pass an exam, but it is not the key for you to finish a paper.
Human has limited memory, you memorized one article when you were in elementary school, you probably would forget now, but without memorizing that article, probably you can’t pass the exam in elementary school.
You can’t say that a PhD doesn’t deserve his/her degree because that he/she can’t memorize the article they learned long time ago.
From my viewpoint, the most valuable thing for a researcher is what they contribute, and this contribution is created from all the resources that they can use, instead of their own human brain!
While in an exam, all the thing you have is your brain, maybe one more calculator.

Actually I would like to apply this statement to all the fields, but I don’t have much understanding of other career, so let me limit it as only applying for data analytics.
At least today there is common sense that you won’t measure a developer’s ability by the certification they hold in their hand.
Like the saying, “Talk is cheap, show me your code”.

entry.title: Game theory in business world and limited rationale assumption in economic
entry.content:
One stupid question has been in my mind for quiet a long time about the application of machine learning on the subject as economy, social sciences, sales & marketing…
It is different comparing with apply the ML to physic experiment, for social sciences related subjects, I would think there would be some sort of “suspicion chain” effect when we apply the technique on the non-physical subject. I would introduce it with an example.
(not sure if “suspicion chain” were interpreted correctly, I quote it from a famous Chinese book “Three-body”)

For example:

Year1:
Company A, used their market data building a model, the data were collected from the past, the purpose is to predict the future sales volume, then they build production plan basing on the prediction, they arrange KPIs to the sales guys, they create market campaign and so on and so forth.

Year2:
With the help of the ML, Company A made a prefect business performance in Year 1, they decided to keep using ML in Year2.
But, Company B step in, they decided to use ML as well.

Things begin to be interesting since then,
Company B knows that Company A was using ML in Year1, and it was quiet successful, and also, Company A really value the result that ML model gives.
then Company B have a big idea, when they implementing ML model, not only they would consider the past market data, they will also consider what Company A would do.
remember, at this time Company A has no idea that Company B would targeting on their trustworthy model. (it is Company B’s top secret, don’t tell others)

then, things would become even interesting in Year3

Year3:
Company A knows that Company B were targeting their model, and basing on that, Company B setup the whole company strategy in Year 2.
So, besides the market data, Company A decides to include Company B’s model in their model.(short for 1st round guess)
But Company B is a new comer, new comer somehow is always with good ideas(kidding), at this time, not only they would consider company A’s model, they would start planning with 2 scenario.

Company A knows Company B’s model, and Company A would include Company B’s model into their consideration, as well as market data(1st round guess)
Company A doesn’t know, or doesn’t get the Company B’s model correctly, then Company A would still use market data as their input
Basing on above 2 scenario, company B build a model, obviously it is with more thinking, they did more work then silly A, then B win. (short for 2nd round guess)
…

Year n:
both Company A and Company B would think about their strategy, their model.
each of them would perform n round or n+m round or even infinite round of guesses. obviously the one with more computing power would win.

The chain is established then.

Today, I didn’t see people building model with that, they just use the historical data.
As if market would be the same, always as the past.
As if other companies would not change their strategy dramatically because other company has considered your idea into account.

Of course the physical world would not change their so called “strategy”.
